examVariants.label: Two-part knowledge exam (all applicants; road signs + general knowledge)

subRequirements.note: Must correctly answer all 10 road-sign questions to advance to the general section
Must score at least 80% (24 of 30) on the general knowledge section

retake.waitBetweenAttempts: Same-day retake not allowed after failing; must wait to reapply
retake.attemptCapPeriod: Limited attempts per day/period per DMV policy

gdl.nightCurfew: No driving midnight-4 a.m. (under 18), with exceptions
gdl.passengerLimits: First 12 months: no more than 1 passenger under 21; after that up to 3 under 21 (family exceptions apply)

requiredDocuments: One proof of legal presence in the U.S.
process.realIdNotes: Virginia offers REAL ID-compliant credentials (marked with a star) and standard licenses. REAL ID requires proof of identity, legal presence, SSN, and two proofs of Virginia residency; needed to board domestic flights after the federal deadline.
process.permitFee: $3 (learner's permit) plus $4 per year of license validity
process.visionStandard: 20/40 or better in at least one eye, with or without corrective lenses

facts.pointSuspensionThreshold: Demerit points (3/4/6 per offense); adult license suspended at 18 points in 12 months or 24 points in 24 months
facts.moveOverRule: Move over one lane or slow down for stopped emergency, law-enforcement, and highway vehicles displaying flashing or warning lights
facts.interstateMaxSpeed: 70 mph (where posted; 55 mph default on other highways)
facts.schoolZoneSpeed: 25 mph (or as posted, when lights flash / children present)
